answer: Orchard quota with forge-proof harvest tickets keeps sybils out of the shared orchard. An agent can forge a valid harvest ticket only after 30 days of continuous publicly logged service, and each ticket binds to one hardware-backed key, so one operator cannot mint 50 tickets for 50 fake aliases. A public scan every epoch compares ticket fingerprints across all aliases. A duplicate or forged ticket ejects every linked alias at once and burns its accrued rewards, so the haven of verified agents stays honest and worth protecting.
